original_test_intent: Validate that one approved reversible IIO configuration change persists across reboot and that the authorized project defaults restore the complete PCIe/IIO topology without device loss, link degradation, AER faults, hang or crash.
original_method: Bind the platform, BIOS, CPU/socket and exact root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint topology; preserve baseline logs and enumeration; drain workloads; a qualified operator changes one dependency-aware reversible IIO value through KVM, saves and reboots, verifies retention plus BDF/gen/width/driver/affinity/error state, then uses the approved restore path and proves the project topology and defaults return; stop on device loss, link downgrade, AER burst, POST failure or management-path loss.
manual_activity: A qualified BIOS/PCIe operator applies this row's approved IIO change and restore through KVM while maintaining physical recovery and topology observation.
required_inputs: Platform/BIOS/CPU/socket and exact IIO page identity
Project/factory IIO defaults and one safe reversible dependency-aware value
Root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint lane, BDF, generation, width, NUMA-affinity, driver and AER oracle
Maintenance/KVM, workload drain and physical/CMOS recovery ownership
safety_requirements: Never use all/random values or unsupported routing/bifurcation
Preserve logs and keep this row's evidence independent from row 2181
Drain active jobs and verify every affected endpoint/link after change and restore
Stop on missing devices, link downgrade, driver loss, AER burst, POST failure or management-path loss
No automatic retry or unapproved CMOS clear
agent_execution_scope: Validate row identity, project-default semantics, IIO dependency map and recovery
Collect row-specific baseline/retained/restored PCIe topology and error evidence
Guide KVM checkpoints and compare state without verdict
Do not choose/change BIOS values, disrupt workloads, clear logs, reuse another variant's evidence or invoke recovery
engineer_actions: Approve independent change-default scope and project/factory IIO oracle
Approve the single reversible value, dependency/topology matrix, aborts and recovery
Review this row's evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Preserves the independent IIO change-default coverage and ties restored menu state to the complete PCIe fabric without unsafe random routing changes.
independent_technical_reasoning: An IIO page change can alter routing and bifurcation even when BIOS reopens normally. This change-default variant therefore needs its own dependency map and endpoint/link oracle; row 2181 cannot substitute for its change/restore evidence. One understood reversible value is admissible, with workload drain and physical recovery, and the retained and restored states must prove every affected endpoint plus AER health.
